lines.text: Read this sentence. The animal did not cross the street, because it was too tired.
What does the word it mean? You know it means the animal. A language model has to work that out too.
So every word gets three paper tags. A question. A label. And a value.
The word it holds up its question: which earlier word am I about?
Every other word shows its label. The better a label matches the question, the thicker the paper strip that links them.
Animal gets a thick strip. Street gets a thin one.
Now the model copies each word's value, in proportion to its strip, and blends them together.
The word it now carries the meaning of animal.
Do this for every word, many times over, and that is attention.
